title: Recording, mixing: Sisters, O Sisters, The Luck Of The Irish, Angela, Woman Is The N****r Of The World, Born In A Prison by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1972
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Phil Spector

An overdub session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Some Time In New York City album took place on 18 March 1972.

Strings, credited to Invisible Strings, were added to five songs: ‘Sisters, O Sisters’, ‘The Luck Of The Irish’, ‘Angela’, ‘Woman Is The N****r Of The World’, and ‘Born In A Prison’.

After the overdubs were completed, ‘Sisters, O Sisters’ and ‘Woman Is The N****r Of The World’ were mixed in stereo.
